create_LLVMProjects_single_tree: create LLVM project list for a single source tree checkout with all projects under tools/ and projects/
create_LLVMProjects_separate_trees: create LLVM project list for separate directory checkouts with clang-tools-extra nested under clang/tools/extra
test_LLVMProject_is_subproject: test if one LLVMProject is a subdirectory of another using the is_subproject method
walk_project_files: walk all files in an LLVM project directory while skipping subprojects, .git, and .svn folders
build_LLVMProject_instance: build an LLVMProject instance with a descriptive name and relative checkout path
